name: @frankorozcogt/mcp-chrome-server

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a Chrome tab and save it to a temp file. Returns the file path for reading with an image/file tool. Fails if DevTools is already open on that tab.

tools.name: console
tools.description: Read console messages captured from a Chrome tab. action:'get' (default) ensures capture is on and reads what's captured this session, live — no persistence, nothing to query from before capture started. Results are capped at 100 entries; pass the returned nextOffset to page through more. action:'expand' resolves the full value of a non-primitive argument via its objectId (from a 'get' entry's objectIds) — only valid until the page navigates. action:'stop' detaches the debugger, which also stops network capture if it was running (they share one attach).

offset.description: get only. Pass the previous call's nextOffset to page through more entries

objectId.description: expand only. From a 'get' entry's objectIds

tools.name: network
tools.description: Capture and read network requests for a Chrome tab. Order: start, trigger traffic, get, stop. Network and console capture share one debugger attach per tab, so action:'stop' also stops console capture if it was running. action:'get' lists requests summarized (method, URL, status) this session, live — capped at 100, page with the returned nextOffset. action:'detail' fetches full response body and POST data for one request (by its requestId from a 'get' entry) straight from Chrome's own buffer — no retroactive capture, and detail is only available while that request's data is still in Chrome's buffer.

action.description: start: begin capture. stop: end capture. get: list captured requests. detail: full body/postData for one request

filter.description: get only. Substring filter on request URL

offset.description: get only. Pass the previous call's nextOffset to page through more requests

networkRequestId.description: detail only. requestId from a 'get' entry

tools.name: elements
tools.description: Query DOM elements by CSS selector in a Chrome tab. Returns up to 50 matches, each with childCount and (if includeChildren:true) childSelectors — one ready-to-use selector per direct child, scoped under the original selector, to drill into a specific child on a follow-up call instead of matching the whole subtree at once. Results are further capped at 100 lines; page with the returned nextOffset.

includeChildren.description: Include childSelectors for each match's direct children. Default: false

offset.description: Pass the previous call's nextOffset to page through more matches

tools.name: interact
tools.description: Interact with a DOM element by CSS selector in a Chrome tab: click, type, scroll into view, or focus.

tools.name: tabs
tools.description: List open Chrome tabs or create a new one. Call this before any other tool to learn or create the tabId to target.

tools.name: setup
tools.description: Diagnose and (re)provision the Chrome native messaging host. Call this if browser tools fail with a no-connected-extension error. Returns native-host registration status and bridge connection state.
